_note: Batch 11: ten REAL Perth family and women's health providers researched from public information on 10 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'family' practice category: doulas, lactation consultants, fertility support, women's health practitioners, men's health, midwives, pregnancy yoga and parenting coaches. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Health-claims discipline is at its strictest: services are described by what they ARE (visit formats, credentials such as IBCLC and endorsed midwife, admitting rights, schedules, prices) with no outcome, success-rate or treatment claims — Parenting Collective's advertised '100% success rate' is deliberately NOT repeated, and fertility copy describes support during cycles, never results. Excluded during research: Blomma Momma (Washington state USA, not WA Australia), mamamilk (site unreachable at research time). Stirling, Kingsley and Alexander Heights added to the Northern Suburbs region.

listings.name: Back to Basics Birthing
listings.blurb: Vicki Hobbs has spent more than twenty years alongside Perth families as a birth and postpartum doula, childbirth educator and doula trainer. Her calendar covers hypnobirthing and VBAC education, caesarean birth preparation, birth debriefing, pregnancy and postpartum massage, mother blessings and placenta encapsulation, in person and online.
listings._source: vickihobbs.com — 20+ years experience, doula/education/massage service list and online courses confirmed; suburb, prices, phone and email not published on the pages checked

listings.name: The Gentle Village
listings.blurb: A Stirling-based team of endorsed midwives and IBCLC lactation consultants covering pregnancy, postpartum and infant feeding — private midwifery, lactation consults, antenatal classes and tongue-tie care, with appointments in clinic, at home or online.
listings._source: thegentlevillage.com.au — Stirling base, endorsed midwife + IBCLC team, service list and clinic/home/online formats confirmed; bookings run through Cliniko, no phone/email in page text, prices unpublished

listings.name: Before & After Baby
listings.blurb: An endorsed private practice midwife offering continuity of care across pregnancy, birth and the postnatal weeks — at home births and hospital births alike, with admitting access at King Edward Memorial and Fiona Stanley hospitals and lactation consulting alongside. A free discovery call starts the conversation.
listings._source: beforeandafterbaby.com.au — endorsed PPM status, KEMH and FSH admitting rights, homebirth/hospital service list and free discovery call confirmed; midwife's name, fees, phone and email not shown on pages checked

listings.name: Aligned & Centred Acupuncture
listings.blurb: An Alexander Heights clinic where acupuncturists Shannon and Ethan work alongside a naturopath and massage therapist, with a focus on fertility care — acupuncture during natural conception, through IVF cycles and embryo transfer, in early pregnancy, and for male fertility — plus group fertility sessions.
listings._source: alignedcentredacupuncture.com.au/fertility — address, phone, email, practitioner names and fertility service scope confirmed; AHPRA logo displayed, individual registrations not listed; copy describes support during cycles only, no outcome claims

listings.name: Hug Pelvic Physio
listings.blurb: Louise Hug's pelvic physiotherapy practice sees both women and men — pregnancy and postpartum care, bladder and bowel concerns, sexual health, pelvic rehabilitation following cancer care and general exercise-based rehab, with an explicit welcome for LGBTQIA+ clients and telehealth available.
listings._source: pelvichug.com — practitioner name, women's and men's service lists, LGBTQIA+ services and telehealth confirmed; bookings via Nookal, suburb/address, prices, phone and email not published

listings.name: The Woom
listings.blurb: A West Perth women's health clinic whose physiotherapists work across pelvic floor concerns — prolapse, urinary leakage, pelvic pain — and antenatal and postnatal care, as part of a broader women's health practice.
listings._source: thewoom.com.au/womens-health-physiotherapist-west-perth — West Perth location and pelvic-health physiotherapy scope confirmed from their page title and summary; deeper details (prices, contact) not captured

listings.name: Bloom Yoga Studio
listings.blurb: A northern-suburbs studio built around pregnancy and women's yoga: five-week pregnancy courses for every trimester, yoga for active birth, mum-and-baby postnatal classes and women's immersions, plus prenatal yoga teacher training for teachers who want the specialty.
listings._source: bloomyoga.com.au — class list, five-week pregnancy course format and email confirmed on their site (which states Kingsley); the phone and a Glengarry Shopping Centre (Duncraig) address appear in third-party listings, so the street address is left blank pending confirmation

listings.name: Parenting Collective
listings.blurb: Donna, a certified sleep specialist and parenting coach, works one-to-one with Perth families on sleep and day-to-day parenting for children from newborn to ten — 21-day sleep support packages ($599 + GST), coaching sessions, masterclasses and a members' community, by video or in the home. No cry-it-out methods.
listings._source: parentingcollective.com.au — certifications, package price ($599 + GST), formats, age range and no-CIO approach confirmed; their advertised '100% success rate' is deliberately not repeated; contact is via a free 15-minute call booking

listings.name: Baby and Me
listings.blurb: A postnatal and lactation service combining midwifery, child health nursing and IBCLC lactation consulting in one practitioner visit — covering feeding, settling and the everyday questions of the first months at home in Perth.
listings._source: babyandmepostnatal.com.au — combined midwifery / child health / IBCLC model confirmed from their site summary; suburb, prices and direct contact details not captured on the pages checked

listings.name: The Family Room WA
listings.blurb: A Perth hub running the span from birth preparation classes through to postpartum care and support for new families — group classes and individual sessions under one roof, with a focus on the transition into parenthood rather than any single discipline.
listings._source: thefamilyroom.au — birth-preparation-to-postpartum scope confirmed from their site title and summary; suburb, schedule, prices and direct contact not captured on the pages checked
